title: Observer sufficiency: CLS history versus current CLS and all-token representations
scope: New exploratory observational study of all six development-exposed frozen U7C checkpoints. User requested continue next study on 2026-09-11. This changes scope from training repair to limited-probe decodability; it is not T1-U8 advancement or confirmation.
prior_results: U7C and matched audit remain failed all-seed competence protocols; original T1 negative findings retained. No successful-seed-only selection.
model_variant: U7C only; fixed before probe outcomes; auxiliary-supervised regime

data.exclusions: Exclude exact clean/counterfactual family matches to every model training and validation stream and both previously used clean/causal evaluation suites; reject duplicate families across the new probe dataset. Equivalent pair-order permutations are not excluded.
data.pair_key: lexicographic minimum of uint8 clean and label-complement token byte strings; same family for both pair members
data.split_unit: counterfactual family; all steps and both members stay together

primary_target: V_l = true-label NLL_l - true-label NLL_6; probabilities clipped to [1e-8,1]; negative values retained
secondary_target: Decision-flip prevalence is diagnostic only; no binary probe fit or decision-stability advantage claim

eligibility.computed_on: probe-training partition only, before outcome comparisons

observables.cls_current: 32 CLS residual components + 2 probabilities + entropy_bits + absolute_probability_margin = 36
observables.full_current: all 12 token residual vectors in fixed token-position order + same prediction summaries = 388
observables.past: CLS 36-component observables at steps 1 through l-1; step 0 excluded; append past to unchanged current observations
observables.attention: No attention features in this study; no attention-specific mechanism claim

probe.selection: minimum validation MSE; exact ties choose larger alpha
probe.preprocessing: Each final feature column standardized using probe-training means and population SD only; floor SD at 1e-8
probe.target_scaling: center on training mean, no target rescaling
probe.numeric_dtype: float64 for ridge solves and targets; float32 model observations

controls.dimension_control: Current plus fixed Gaussian linear projections of training-standardized current, with exactly 36*(l-1) appended columns
controls.rff: Current plus 36*(l-1) cosine random Fourier features of training-standardized current, W_ij~N(0,1/d_current), bias~Uniform(0,2pi). Same fitted coefficient count as history; fixed transforms and compute are not identical.
controls.shuffle: Independently permute past-step slots per family, same permutation for both pair members, same policy across train/validation/test. Keep current fixed; l=2 aliases ordered and cannot test chronology.
controls.sample_mismatch: Within each partition use a nonzero cyclic donor-family shift, preserving pair member index and all current features; no family donates to itself
controls.residualization: Predict raw flattened CLS past from standardized current using ridge alpha=1 trained only on training features; append residual past to current

primary_comparison.necessary_reference_check: ordered_history versus current_linear must also meet the same screen
primary_comparison.metric: test delta R2 = R2(history)-R2(current); report MAE advantage = MAE(current)-MAE(history)
primary_comparison.threshold_rationale: Fixed exploratory screening convention: one percentage point of explained variance. This is not calibrated to controller utility or compute savings.

aggregation.step_weight: Equal weight across training-eligible steps within each seed
aggregation.seed_weight: Equal weight across all six fixed seeds
aggregation.uncertainty: 1000 bootstrap replicates of held-out counterfactual families within each seed, retaining both members and common draws across steps and arms; six model seeds fixed, not resampled
aggregation.interval: percentile 2.5% and 97.5%; conditional on fixed models and fitted probes, not a model-seed population CI
aggregation.secondary: CLS observer, prior pass/fail strata, and history controls are exploratory descriptive comparisons; no multiple-testing-adjusted discovery claim

screen_rule: Full-history passes exploratory screen only if both primary and necessary reference comparisons have mean delta R2 >=0.01, conditional bootstrap lower bound >0, positive mean delta R2 for every one of the six seeds, and nonnegative panel mean MAE advantage. All seeds must have at least one training-eligible step. Failure is reported as no robust advantage under this protocol, not broad falsification. Ineligible panel is distinct. No automatic confirmation advancement under any result.

budgets.probe_execution_retries: Only documented implementation-error recovery using identical frozen protocol; preserve partial run logs. No outcome-driven reruns.

stop_rule: Finish the fixed extraction and ridge panel once, then report all seeds, steps, controls, eligibility and uncertainty. Do not open reserved seeds or optimize model training based on the result.
